usedFor: viaSocket Table holds records, and Microsoft Excel receives them as rows through “Add Row To Table” and “Update Row”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Row Created” in viaSocket Table, then “Add Row To Table” in Microsoft Excel
bestTemplate.why: Each new record is copied into an Excel table as a row.

watchOut: “New Row Created” only covers new rows, so edits need a second template on “Record Is Updated”.
